about_the_game:
is a psychological horror walking sim set in eerie, liminal spaces. Explore unsettling environments, solve intricate puzzles, and unravel the mystery of your strange surroundings.

  • Authentic VHS Camera System – Experience the horror through a vintage VHS lens, adding a nostalgic and unsettling touch to your journey.

  • Deeply Immersive Liminal Spaces – Explore intricately designed locations that feel familiar yet disturbingly empty.

  • Atmospheric Audio Design – Reactive soundscapes and spatial audio make you feel like you're the one walking and filming every moment.

  • Cinematic VHS Aesthetic – Grainy visuals, subtle distortions, and analog effects pull you into the experience.

  • Environmental Puzzles – Solve thought-provoking challenges woven seamlessly into the eerie surroundings.

  • Hidden Lore & Narrative Fragments – Discover cryptic messages and clues that reveal the unsettling truth behind this world.

  • Minimalist VHS-Styled Menus – A UI that feels like an extension of the experience, keeping you fully immersed.

  • Intuitive Exploration-Driven Gameplay – No combat, no distractions—just you, the silence, and the unknown.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: With the minimum requirements, you can expect around 60 FPS on Medium settings, though performance may vary depending on your system and configuration.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: With the recommended requirements, you can achieve around 60 FPS on Ultra settings, though performance may vary based on your system and configuration.
